held.UPSIT: No verified historical calendar assessment date; nominal source conflicts are resolved but timing is not. Excluded, not imputed.

SC_BL_selection: Strict monthly INFODT, latest within prior three months through RNA month-end landmark, BL before SC within that month, select before value QC, conflicting relevant fields within selected month/event held; no favourable fallback.
LNS: Binary items; require complete triples until first all-zero triple, permit missing/zero unadministered tail only, sum must equal supplied raw total.
JLO: Version1 odd and version2 even items, all 15 binary active items, other items blank; native sum and calculated score=2*raw must agree. Raw scale0..15; form indicator attached.
HVLT_recognition: Correct recognition minus two false-positive fields; native trial sums, delayed score and form must match frozen enhanced assessment.
blood_pressure: Use observed supine-minus-standing differences only, not diagnosis of OH. Historical standing duration and medication timing remain unverified contextual limitations. Optional missing scores retained with training-only imputation. The archived5/6/10 source form specifies1–3 minutes in each posture; individual adherence remains unrecorded.
APOE: Valid source consensus E2/E3/E4 pair, dosage0..2, no flagged identity notes, WGS presence inventory. Static retrospectively ascertained germline trait; no claim the test was known at baseline or ancestry-adjusted causal effect.
NLR: Latest source month/event before QC; same draw, absolute GI/L units, positive uncensored counts, benign/verified comments only, normal or H/L flags retained, nonfuture known report month, conflicting latest absolute draw pairs held. Feature is natural-log NLR, raw ratio retained for provenance.
missingness: Do not remove otherwise eligible participants because optional scores are missing. Apply training-only median imputation, missingness indicator and standardized continuous features as locked subsequently. No imputation for wholly unavailable UPSIT.
